q1: SELECT O1.SEAT_ID FROM CINEMA O1 WHERE O1.FREE = 1 AND ((SELECT FREE FROM CINEMA O2 WHERE O2.SEAT_ID = O1.SEAT_ID - 1) = 1 OR (SELECT FREE FROM CINEMA O2 WHERE O2.SEAT_ID = O1.SEAT_ID + 1) = 1)
q2: SELECT DISTINCT C1.SEAT_ID FROM CINEMA AS C1 JOIN CINEMA AS C2 ON C2.SEAT_ID - C1.SEAT_ID = 1 OR C1.SEAT_ID - C2.SEAT_ID =1 WHERE C1.FREE = 1 AND C2.FREE = 1 ORDER BY SEAT_ID
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT O1.SEAT_ID FROM CINEMA O1 WHERE O1.FREE = 1 AND ((SELECT FREE FROM CINEMA O2 WHERE O2.SEAT_ID = O1.SEAT_ID - 1) = 1 OR (SELECT FREE FROM CINEMA O2 WHERE O2.SEAT_ID = O1.SEAT_ID + 1) = 1)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT C1.SEAT_ID FROM CINEMA AS C1 JOIN CINEMA AS C2 ON C2.SEAT_ID - C1.SEAT_ID = 1 OR C1.SEAT_ID - C2.SEAT_ID =1 WHERE C1.FREE = 1 AND C2.FREE = 1 ORDER BY SEAT_ID
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 selects seat IDs where the seat is free and at least one of its adjacent seats is also free. Q2 selects seat IDs where the seat is free and there is another free seat immediately next to it, in either direction.
counterexample_dsp: A cinema with three seats, where the middle seat is free and the seats on either side are occupied.
